vibe_rationale: Community-run, non-profit street-art festival with village hosts, workshops and curated murals, but one scene and not large, so narrower than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: A mural or installation commission is the natural format, and the visible partner list and public contact page make the route open. Schoolchildren attend the workshops and wellness adjacency is weak, so the adult health fit is limited. Bali-based, so an Australian brand would need local partners.
